import pandas as pd
import re
ben = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
# payments
pay_raw = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', header=None)
# find header row
header_idx = pay_raw[pay_raw[0]=='Payment ID'].index[0]
cols = pay_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
data = pay_raw.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
data.columns = cols
data = data[['Payment ID','Beneficiary ID','Amount (INR)','Status']].dropna(subset=['Beneficiary ID'])
# clean
def clean_id(x):
    return str(x).strip()
data['Beneficiary ID'] = data['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
ben['Beneficiary ID'] = ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
# status
data['Status_clean'] = data['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
data_paid = data[data['Status_clean']=='paid']
# exclude ids not in ben
valid_ids = set(ben['Beneficiary ID'])
data_paid = data_paid[data_paid['Beneficiary ID'].isin(valid_ids)]
# parse amount
def parse_amount(x):
    s = str(x)
    s = s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # remove any non-digit dot
    m = re.search(r'[\\d\\.]+', s)
    if m:
        try:
            return float(m.group())
        except:
            return None
    return None
data_paid['Amount_num'] = data_paid['Amount (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)
# merge
merged = data_paid.merge(ben, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
# filter
filtered = merged[(merged['State'].str.strip().str.lower()=='odisha') & (merged['Programme'].str.strip()==\"Girls' Education\")]
total = filtered['Amount_num'].sum()
print('rows', len(filtered))
print(total)
print(filtered[['Beneficiary ID','Full Name','Amount_num']].head())
\"
